data.one_liner: Isolated file download manager with progress, pause, resume and cancellation.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Dart‑only download manager that runs downloads in reusable isolates. It offers real‑time progress events and controls for pause, resume and cancel, plus a queue system.
use_when: You need background downloads without blocking the UI
You require progress reporting and the ability to pause or resume downloads
You want a pure‑Dart solution that works across Android, iOS, Windows, macOS and Linux
avoid_when: A simple one‑off HTTP GET is sufficient
You need native platform download optimizations or system‑level notifications
strengths: Runs downloads in isolates, keeping the UI responsive
Supports pause, resume, cancel and queue management
Provides real‑time progress events via streams
weaknesses: Limited to Dart’s http client, no native download acceleration
Adds complexity compared to a direct http call
No built‑in UI, requires a separate Flutter package for widgets
